question: May the newly installed Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 pw.x execute exactly one isolated local single-process silicon Davidson SCF tutorial smoke test and compare its mechanical outputs with the accepted QE 7.2 tutorial record?

options.summary: Run one isolated QE 7.5 SCF tutorial smoke test and compare outputs.
options.consequence: Stage the retained portable tutorial input and exact legacy pseudopotential into a new external workspace, invoke the identified QE 7.5 pw.x exactly once with one MPI process, retain compact execution and artifact observations, and compare mechanical and printed results with the accepted QE 7.2 tutorial without claiming production convergence or scientific validation.

options.summary: Do not execute the smoke test.
options.consequence: Retain only static input compatibility and installation evidence; QE 7.5 runtime, pseudopotential, QEXSD, and output comparison remain untested.

recommendation: Option A, because the bounded smoke test directly verifies whether the retained silicon tutorial input and pseudopotential execute under the newly selected QE 7.5 binary while preserving the accepted QE 7.2 evidence.

human_response: run smoke test and compare outputs
